notes: title_boost=0.05 DA DUOC HIEU CHINH LAI theo so do cua phase 8, dung nhu plan du lieu ([ASSUMED] cho toi khi phase 8 do xong). Do duoc: cross-encoder tra ve logit khong chan, khoang -12 den -4, nen +0.05 la ~0.4% cua dai — VO HINH. Voi noop reranker (cau hinh duoc khuyen nghi sau phase 8) diem la RRF 0.25-1.0, o do 0.05 la ~6% — CO Y NGHIA. Da ghi rang buoc nay thang vao comment cua configs.py va default.yaml de nguoi doc sau khong phai tu suy ra.

Quy tac 1 (cap theo nguon) la danh doi CO Y: neu tai lieu dung that su co 3 chunk lien quan nhat, cap ve 2 se day mot chunk tot ra de nhuong cho mot chunk kem hon tu nguon khac. Da doi da dang nguon lay do sau. Cach kiem no co dang khong la nhin DANH SACH CASE DOI CHO o buoc eval — buoc dang bi chan.

Quy tac 2 (gop) co mat mat da biet va da thanh test chu khong phai tai nan: score lay MAX (khong phai tong — tong se thuong cho viec gop va lam hong xep hang), page va title lay cua chunk index nho nhat. Hau qua that: trich dan co the tro vao trang dau cua cap trong khi cau tra loi nam o trang sau, va UI hien dung con so do. Muon tat: merge_adjacent=false.

KHONG dung retrieval/vector_search.py du ban nhap goi y. Tang nay thao tac tren list[RetrievedChunk] SAU rerank, tuc la o tang orchestrator. Nhet vao vector_search la bat vector store biet ve mot tang chay sau no — dung loai dao nguoc phu thuoc ma tang adaptor ton tai de ngan.

Cong cua phase theo phase file la 'top_k cuoi = 5 va ngan sach token da do bang so that tren van ban tieng Viet'. Ca hai DA DAT: top_k mac dinh = 5 o ca configs.py, default.yaml va index.html; ngan sach do duoc 4783/6000. Verdict PASS_WITH_RISK vi hai muc can ha tang that (so sanh eval va nghiem thu hai-tai-lieu) bi chan boi proxy, khong phai vi cong chua dat.
